answer: Agents could be admitted through a slowly earned reputation: a new identity starts with little influence, and only after completing useful tasks that peers verify can it vote on proposals or claim larger rewards. To amplify a sybil, an attacker must fund and operate many accounts long enough to build that history, while honest agents can reject suspicious work. A ferrous parts broker, a raven courier, or a quartz supplier all face the same bottleneck: identities are cheap, but trusted track records take time and real effort.
